_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); railroad signals

pit_profile.why: Union Pacific: the largest railroad in North America, covering 23 states across the western two-thirds of the US, with BNSF its main rail competitor on parallel routes; carload volume follows the industrial economy, the franchise does not

classification.quality_note: Union Pacific: the largest railroad in North America, covering 23 states across the western two-thirds of the US, with BNSF its main rail competitor on parallel routes; carload volume follows the industrial economy, the franchise does not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 4.31x; +50% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.24; conservative 2yr -5%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -7.7%/yr (worst year FY14-FY23, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +5.4%/yr (Q4 2023 revenue + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +6.9%/yr (FY14-FY23 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +24.9%/yr (best 2-yr run FY14-FY23); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: UNP (retrospective, 2024-04-12) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 4.31x (36.0% downside to Bear $150 / +8.4% upside to Bull $254) | Adj composite 2.13 vs market 3.37: gap -1.24 [OVERVALUED] | +50% above the EPP floor $157 (15x FY24E $10.45) | Conservative 2-yr case: -4.8% total (-2.4%/yr) | At 22.4x FY24E the 15% hurdle price $310 sits above the BULL case; carloads +3% in Q4 2023, forward revenue +1% (no FY24 revenue guide, Q4 2023 freight revenue); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
